item.description: In an outdoor setting with green trees in the background and sandy soil in the foreground, a low red-brick wall with an L-shaped corner/junction stands in the midground. Bricks are laid on edge with grey mortar in the joints, and excess wet mortar rests along the base on the ground. A long silver metal bar lies across the foreground dirt. At 0.0s, the adult male worker (ent_worker) is standing bent forward behind the central brick corner with his head partly above the top frame edge. By 0.6s, he bends lower so his head and face are fully in frame, looking down behind the wall while speaking (sp_01) and reaching with his arms behind the brickwork (hands occluded). Around 1.8s to 2.5s, he turns his head to look toward screen left while speaking and listening to the off-screen reply (sp_02). From 2.6s to 3.4s, he looks back down behind the wall. From 3.5s to 4.8s, he looks up toward screen left again while speaking (sp_03) and shifts slightly toward screen left behind the wall.
